Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
 Your Role
 As a Data Engineer Databricks, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing data solutions within a modern Azure ecosystem. You will contribute to data ingestion, migration, transformation, quality assurance, and reporting activities while collaborating closely with development, infrastructure, and business teams.
 In This Role You Will
Implement data ingestion processes in Databricks. 
Support the migration and recovery of historical data from Teradata. 
Ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability across the platform. 
Build data aggregations based on functional specifications provided by business teams. 
Collaborate with development and infrastructure teams to ensure smooth integration. 
Contribute to data management best practices and standards. 
Analyze and resolve incidents related to reports and dashboards in IBM Cognos Analytics. 
Develop and maintain reports using IBM Cognos Analytics. 
Participate in testing, deployment, and user support activities. 
Work within a DevOps and CI/CD environment using Azure DevOps. 
 Your Profile
Relevant professional experience in data engineering or a comparable data-focused role.
Hands-on experience with Databricks and Microsoft Azure
Strong SQL knowledge and experience working with data transformation and aggregation.
Experience with IBM Cognos Analytics, including report development, maintenance, and incident resolution.
Knowledge of Teradata and experience with historical data migration are valued.
Experience working with DevOps and CI/CD practices, particularly Azure DevOps.
Professional fluency in French and English.
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving ability, attention to detail, communication, and teamwork skills.
 What You Will Love About Working Here
Software Engineer Community: Join a global community of 100,000+ software engineering professionals and expand your network through client and executive interactions.
Diverse & Impactful Projects: Develop your expertise across a wide range of missions, technologies, and sectors, with meaningful autonomy and room for initiative.
Continuous Learning: Access comprehensive training platforms and recognized certifications.
Flexibility & Balance: Benefit from hybrid working policies that allow you to manage your time and work location effectively.
